════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ONE FAILURE DURING THE APPLY, CAUGHT BY THE MIGRATION ITSELF

Part 2 failed on its first attempt and rolled back:

    ERROR: M3: kw_unit_label is still anon-callable

The migration said `revoke execute ... from anon`. That does nothing: `anon`
INHERITS PUBLIC's grant, the ACL read `=X/postgres`, and
has_function_privilege('anon', ...) stayed true. It needed
`from public, anon`.

This is CLAUDE.md's own standing rule about PUBLIC — the rule this project
wrote down after the _org_indicator_counts incident — and I broke it while
writing a migration whose entire purpose is confidentiality. The post-condition
I had written caught it, refused the apply, and rolled the whole file back.

Between the two attempts, live was in the intermediate state Part 1's header
warns about: policies written, definer functions unfiltered. That window was
about ninety seconds and was closed by re-applying Part 2 rather than by
investigating first.

Both source files are corrected.

  2 counsellor_clients ('M3 PROBE client')
  2 counselling_notes
  the _m3matrix / _m3c helper tables and their probe functions

  Test Co Q3 total_booked is back to 8, its original value.

════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
THREE THINGS THE MATRIX SHOWS THAT ARE WORTH KNOWING

1. FRANCE IS THE TEAM LEAD, THE ADMIN AND AN HR ACCOUNT. His single row carries
   both the "France-type admin" and the "financial team lead" assertions.
   There is no non-admin team lead on live to test separately.

2. THE PLAIN ADVISOR ROW PROVES NOTHING, before or after. It reads 0 financial
   in both phases — not because a policy denies it, but because only 2 of 5
   advisors carry a user_id, so current_advisor_id() does not resolve. An
   identity failure wearing the costume of an access decision.

3. LONE READS PSYCHOSOCIAL BOOKINGS AND NO NOTES. That asymmetry is deliberate
   and is now demonstrated rather than asserted.

STILL TRUE AFTER M3

  There is no Clinical Lead and no object named is_clinical_lead.
  counselling_notes has exactly one policy: the author.
  counselling_referrals is the only path between counsellors, and its note is
  freshly authored — reading a referral grants no access to the referring
  counsellor's notes.
  The risk-flag interim is NOT built.
  The accept-flow RPC is NOT built (4a/4b were answered; the RPC is next).
